_comment: Harbor job template pointing the codex solver agent at the local Qwen server.
How this reaches the server: Harbor runs the agent in a container, so 127.0.0.1 is
the container, not the host. 172.17.0.1 is the docker0 bridge gateway = the host.
SGLang binds 0.0.0.0:8888, so the container can reach it there.
Why these exact keys: harbor/agents/installed/codex.py reads OPENAI_BASE_URL and
writes `openai_base_url` into the container's CODEX_HOME/config.toml, because codex
0.118.0 only honors it from config.toml and ignores the env var. model_name is split
on '/' and the last segment is passed as `codex exec --model`, so the part after
IMPORTANT: export OPENAI_API_KEY (any non-empty value) before run_harbor_job.sh.
That script sets CODEX_FORCE_AUTH_JSON=1 when OPENAI_API_KEY is unset, which would
upload your real ~/.codex/auth.json and try to authenticate against api.openai.com
